On vtes-l, Martin Ward <mnw...@AURACOM.COM> wrote:
> Yes, it's YAQ about Form of Mist.
>
> Well, I abused this card in a voting deck recently and some people
> believe
> that because of the phrase "as if unblocked" that the blocking minion
> gets to
> untap. I say the minion could block if he played WWEF, but that's it.
>
> So, what's the answer?

Form of Mist does not untap the blocker.
"The action continues as if unblocked." This does not address the blocker.

> And I should add, that one of the players emailed WOTC to get an answer
> on
> this and they said that the blocker gets to untap. Now I haven't seen a
> printout of the reply, but if I do, I can let you know who the repondent
> was.

As of March 1997, all VtES questions e-mailed to WotC are forwarded
to me, so that the answers given will be consistent.
